zh.title: 修复版 Beta：记忆默认关闭
zh.description: 本次优先修复稳定性。记忆仍处于试验阶段，新配置默认关闭；已有显式设置保留。需要时可在设置中开启试用，已有笔记不会因关闭而删除。记忆质量与成本验收尚未完成

zh.title: 工具出错后的状态更准确
zh.description: 保留原始工具错误，并单独显示后续是否已恢复；证据不足时不判定为已恢复。重开会话后仍保留这些状态

zh.title: 停止与续聊衔接更稳
zh.description: 手动停止后，新消息可以继续当前会话；没有新消息时不会因停止而重发。切换会话和重连时，也会核对实际执行状态

zh.title: 修复同步与跳转到最新内容
zh.description: 修复切换同步方式后消息未初始化的问题；向上滚动后点击跳转到底部，现在会立即回到最新内容

zh.title: 改文件和模型兼容性修复
zh.description: 补全缺失补丁边界标记，改善编辑失败的提示；修复 DeepSeek 自动降级后的模式记录和 Windows 读取缺失文件的错误分类

en.title: Repair Beta: memory is off by default
en.description: This release prioritizes stability. Memory remains experimental and is off in new configurations; explicit existing settings are preserved. You can enable it in Settings, and turning it off does not delete saved notes. Memory quality and cost acceptance is not complete

en.title: Clearer status after tool errors
en.description: Original tool errors stay visible, with a separate indication of subsequent recovery. Insufficient evidence is not treated as recovery. These states remain available after reopening a session

en.title: More reliable stop and continuation
en.description: A new message can continue the session after a manual stop; stopping alone does not resend the request. Session switching and reconnection also check the actual execution state

en.title: Synchronization and jump-to-latest fixes
en.description: Fixed missing message initialization after switching synchronization modes. Clicking the jump-to-bottom control after scrolling up now returns immediately to the latest content

en.title: File editing and model compatibility fixes
en.description: Accepts patches with missing boundary markers and improves edit-failure guidance. Fixes mode provenance after DeepSeek fallback and error classification for missing files on Windows
